newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ABB says forms Czech ventilation unit.
newsitem.headline: ABB says forms Czech ventilation unit.

text.p: Swiss-Swedish engineering concern Asea Brown Boveri said on Friday it had formed its ninth Czech subsidiary, ABB Final Ventilace s.r.o..

ABB s.r.o., its Czech daughter company, said in a statement that the new firm had taken over activities of two ventilation engineering, project management, supplies and ductwork production subsidiaries of local firm Janka a.s..
ABB's Czech operations vice-president, Hans Wikse, said Janka would in reutrn get production orders.
"The aim of the new company is to create a strong local ABB company, with roughly 180 employees, which will be a guarantor of these activities on the Czech market," Wikse told Reuters.
"It is a small operation and therefore it will not require much investment. The main business is the installation business," he added.
The statement added the subsidiary will be based in Radotin, just outside of Prague.
ABB employs over 6,500 people in its Czech operations.
